rows.en: Defeat the entire Phantom Army!
Defeat Emperor Banba!

This stage is debug mode. The new Kamen Riders and all characters will appear.

The old Kamen Riders can be checked in Episode 25, [VAR6]F in Episode 34, and Kamen Rider RX in Episode 39.
<c3>Shiro Kazami</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Shiro Kazami</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
The experiment is a success… With an injection of fresh human blood, Ganikomol has come back to life!
Ganikomol, awaken!
Now, suck the blood of humans, revive one monster after another, and prepare for Gel-Shocker's great offensive!

But… before that, there's something I absolutely must do!

Kamen Rider and his friends, who've made me taste bitter defeat time and again… I will destroy them with my own hands, without fail!!
Eeee!!
Great Leader! Ganikomol is ready to deploy at any time.

At last… our Gel-Shocker's great offensive begins…

But, General Black… will Ganikomol alone be enough? Have you some secret plan?
Leave it to me, Great Leader… I have measures in place.

Mm… I expect great things!

To begin, give Ganikomol his orders!
And those orders are?
There is a group probing our movements… trying to interfere! Destroy that group!
The Anti-Shocker League, I presume?

They are surely going to join forces with the Kamen Riders!

Erase my data from their computer and crush them!
Mmm, beautiful! So beautiful…
Oh… you're doing something cameraman-like for once, aren't you?
I made it a rule never to photograph women, but I can't say no when [HERO4] asks! Well, enjoy the peace while it lasts…
I made it a rule never to photograph women, but I can't say no when [HERO4] asks! Well, enjoy the peace while it lasts…
Why do you say that?
What do you mean?

Hm? It's about time Gel-Shocker started acting up.

Come to think of it… I haven't seen Taki for two or three days. Which means he got some info from the FBI and started investigating?
Those Gel-Shocker bastards!
When the peace goes on too long, they get antsy… They're plotting something again!
We've got trouble!

Speak of the devil!

Still… it's always "We've got trouble!" with you, isn't it, Taki? Stick "Boss!" on the front and you'd be straight out of an old samurai detective show.

Hey…

This is no time for jokes!

It's Gel-Shocker! It seems they're attacking people in town and collecting their blood.

What!? Their blood?

All right… Let's go and see, anyway.
Well, guess I'll get going…
Taki, no sneaking off without me.
Hongo, what are you doing here?
I could ask you the same… Going off without telling me, that's cold! So… I tailed you on the sly!
The thing is… I picked up a strange signal being transmitted from around here.
A Gel-Shocker hideout?
Probably, no doubt about it… They're plotting something again!
Hongo, Taki!
[HERO2]! What are you doing in a place like this?
It seems Gel-Shocker is attacking people in town and collecting their blood.
What!? Their blood?
Looks like… my hunch was right on the money. All right, let's go!
Hongo, Taki!
[HERO2]! What are you doing in a place like this?
It seems Gel-Shocker is attacking people in town and collecting their blood.
I need human blood! To defeat you, among other things! I won't forgive anyone who gets in my way!

Ganikomol!?

I see… You came back by sucking the blood of innocent people?

Damn… This time, I'll finish you off for good! Here I come, Ganikomol!!

Ganikomol!?

I see… You came back by sucking the blood of innocent people?

Damn… This time, I'll finish you off for good! Here I come, Ganikomol!!

Gueeeeh!!

It's too late! Our Gel-Shocker's all-out attack has already begun!

What!? Gel-Shocker's all-out attack?

Taki, I'm worried about Oyassan and the others! Hurry back to the Amigo!!

What!? Gel-Shocker's all-out attack?

Taki, I'm worried about Oyassan and the others! Hurry back to the Amigo!!
Right… Hayato, I'm leaving this to you!
Right… Hongo, I'm leaving this to you!
Uwaaagh!!
Uwaaagh!!
Is Mr. Tobei Tachibana here?
That's me… And who are you?
I'm Seiichiro Kogure of the Anti-Shocker League. I'm sorry for barging in on you so suddenly.
The Anti-Shocker League?
I'm Chie Ishigami. Our organization has branches all over the world.
Well, I never knew that…
Our members are all victims of Shocker and Gel-Shocker. I too… had my only son killed.
In my case, it was my mother.

Well… when it comes to fighting for justice, the more comrades the better!

Let's both do our best! So… what is it you need from me?
The truth is, our computer has uncovered the true identity of Gel-Shocker's Great Leader!
The Great Leader's true identity?
That data will be sent to Cape Tsumeki in Izu at 4 p.m. today.
If we go there ourselves… Gel-Shocker will catch on.
So we would like Kamen Rider to bring that data to us.
Mr. Tachibana, please.

Well, this is a fix…

The Kamen Riders are all out right now… and yet, to make the appointed time, somebody ought to be leaving already…
Y-you're…!? Rider!! Takeshi, is that you? When did you get back? Why, without even sending word…
Y-you're…!? Rider!! Hayato, is that you? When did you get back? Why, without even sending word…

Oyassan…

I got word that Gel-Shocker in Europe was going to launch an all-out attack on Japan, so I rushed back.

Oyassan…

I got word that Gel-Shocker in South America was going to launch an all-out attack on Japan, so I rushed back.

Oh, I see… That must've been rough.

Right off the bat… I've got a favor to ask you.
If it's for the Anti-Shocker League! Ask me anything! Oyassan…

Mm, thanks…

But how do you know about the Anti-Shocker League?
We've got trouble! Oyassan!

uncertain: U04199: 咀る read as 焦る (get antsy).
U04201: 親分をつけたら、捕物帳 (the sidekick's 'Boss, we've got trouble!' cliché from Edo detective dramas) adapted as a samurai detective show reference.
U04245-U04251: this 'Kamen Rider' is the impostor (Shocker Rider) revealed in B0054; lines kept neutral so the twist holds.
